newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Senate backs Moler as deputy energy secretary.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Senate backs Moler as deputy energy secretary.

text.p: The Senate confirmed Elizabeth Moler to be deputy energy secretary by unanimous consent late Thursday, the Senate Energy and Natural Resources Committee said Friday.

Moler goes to the number two job at the Energy Department with extensive energy experience, having been chairwoman of the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission since February 1993 and a commissioner since 1988.
Commission and administration spokesmen said they did not know yet when she would be sworn in to her new position.
During Moler's nine years at the FERC, it completed the restructuring of the wholesale natural gas industry and adopted major rules opening the wholesale power market to competition.
Before joining the commission, she was senior counsel to the Senate Energy and Natural Resources Committee.
